english.note: Use this when criticizing an analysis, understanding, idea, or person as lacking depth or substance.
Use this when someone or something is concerned mainly with superficial matters rather than serious or meaningful ones.

examples.english: Your analysis is too superficial and does not address the causes at all.
examples.traditional: 你呢個分析太膚淺，完全冇講到原因。

examples.english: This analysis is too shallow and has not reached the core of the problem.
examples.traditional: 呢個分析太膚淺，未有觸及問題核心。
